capabilities: Click text inside HTML blocks to open an inline editor
Map DOM click positions back to Markdown source positions
Render larger HTML blocks as interactive widgets with a hover toolbar
Save edits with Enter or cancel with Esc
Sanitize HTML through Obsidian's built-in sanitizeHTMLToDom before rendering
extras: Desktop only; the README notes known limitations with named HTML entities, blocks over 5000 characters, and nesting deeper than 10 levels, and says the community directory listing is still pending.
intentEvidence: instead of competing with Obsidian's native .cm-html-embed.cm-embed-block widget
problem: Obsidian renders HTML blocks in Markdown as read-only embeds in Live Preview, so tweaking their text means switching to source mode and hunting for the right line.
summary: Click-to-edit tool that lets you edit text inside HTML blocks directly in Live Preview via a popover editor.
